files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added

- Support for Nextcloud 33

### Fixed

- Always require user password when deleting an account (even if the user just logged in)

### Changed

- Translations updates
- Dependencies updates

### Removed

- Support for Nextcloud 29
- Support for Nextcloud 30
